title: Hint-Verbalization Rates on Distilled Open Reasoning Models

original_idea.body: Replicate hint-faithfulness protocol on distilled open reasoning models.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: tests whether CoT-monitoring faithfulness findings transfer to accessible models deployers actually use.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Accessible: direct replication with public protocol, public datasets, single GPU.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Tightly scoped replication with well-defined reveal-rate metrics and comparison to published numbers.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Independent-friendly replication on open models; labs unlikely to do small-model replications.

low_compute.reasoning: Inference on 7B-32B open models; single consumer GPU sufficient.

novelty.reasoning: Direct replication of published protocol on new open models; transfer question may be open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Replication on distilled open models is a plausibly open extension.
